  (hratio : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), ↑(r i.succ) ≤ δ * ↑(r i.castSucc))
  (hq1 : (↑n + 1 + 1) * (2 * (↑n + 1 + 1) + 1) / δ ≤ Real.log ↑(q 0))
  (hqr : ∀ (j : Fin (n + 2)), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) {l : ℕ} (hl : 1 ≤ l) (hM1 : 1 ≤ M)
  (hM : M ≤ ↑(q 0) ^ (ε * (↑l * ↑(r 0))))
  (ih :
    ∀ {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ},
      3 ≤ ↑(r (Fin.last n)) →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(r i.succ) ≤ ε * ↑(r i.castSucc)) →
          (↑n + 1) * (2 * (↑n + 1) + 1) / ε ≤ Real.log ↑(q 0) →
            (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) →
              Roth.Θ (↑(q 0) ^ (ε * ↑(r 0))) q r < 10 ^ (n + 1) * ε ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1)) :
  (Roth.Θ M (fun j ↦ q j.castSucc) fun j ↦ l * r j.castSucc) < 10 ^ (n + 1) * ε ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1)

                (∀ (j : Fin (n + 2)), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) →

                    1 ≤ l →
                      1 ≤ M →

                          (∀ {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ},

                                (∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(r i.succ) ≤ ε * ↑(r i.castSucc)) →
                                  (↑n + 1) * (2 * (↑n + 1) + 1) / ε ≤ Real.log ↑(q 0) →
                                    (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) →
                                      Roth.Θ (↑(q 0) ^ (ε * ↑(r 0))) q r < 10 ^ (n + 1) * ε ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1)) →
                            (Roth.Θ M (fun j ↦ q j.castSucc) fun j ↦ l * r j.castSucc) <
                              10 ^ (n + 1) * ε ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1) :=
fun {n} {δ ε M} hδ0 hδε {r q} hanti hrlast hratio hq1 hqr {l} hl hM1 hM ih ↦

    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a ↦ (Roth.Θ _a (fun j ↦ q j.castSucc) fun j ↦ l * r j.castSucc) < 10 ^ (n + 1) * ε ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1))

      ih
        (have h2 := cast (Eq.symm Nat.cast_le._simp_1) (hanti (Fin.last n).castSucc);
